name: Shibuya [Beta]
desc:
Shibuya is a Jujutsu Kaisen inspired fighting game set 1000 years after the original story. Climb the sorcerer grades, earn cursed techniques through hard trials, contain curses instead of exorcising them, and fight in virtual Tube Simulations. The game has hardcore elements, and the stronger you get, the more a careless death can cost you.

L to equip your weapon
Tab to view the leaderboard
Backspace to drop an item
J to devour a contained curse
M1 to attack
M2 or R for a critical attack
Q to dash, hold Q to lunge
F to block, tap F right before a hit to parry
E to infuse your attacks with cursed energy
X to uppercut, X again to rushdown
B to grip NPCs or players
V to carry NPCs, players or objects
P to summon your vehicle


The game is currently in its early stages and things are subject to change/improvement.

llm.loop: climb sorcerer grades -> earn cursed techniques through trials -> contain curses -> fight in Tube Simulations; deaths are costly

unique: containing and devouring curses instead of exorcising
